'''2011 Worlds Day 2 K. Brown DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[K. Brown]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Typed sheet. Line 3/5 Hoth markers V as marked; line 17 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer (V); line 28 The Emperor's Reach → Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (V); line 30 Black Leader → DS-61-2 (V); line 32 Veers → General Veers (V); L39 Imperial Decree non-V / L40 Imperial Decree (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Username:''' darkjediknight11
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
